examples.name: daily_revenue_trend
examples.sql: SELECT CAST(order_time AS DATE) AS order_date, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM orders GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY order_date;

examples.name: purchase_count_trend
examples.sql: SELECT CAST(order_time AS DATE) AS order_date, COUNT(*) AS purchase_count FROM orders GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY order_date;

examples.name: category_revenue_top
examples.sql: SELECT category, SUM(amount) AS total_revenue FROM orders GROUP BY category ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5;
